text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When a program does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs by reproducing the problem and understanding what went wrong. Developers can use debugging tools such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution to examine their code closely. However, a systematic approach is just as important as the tools themselves. Instead of changing code randomly, you should form a clear hypothesis, test it, and check the result. Logging is also a valuable technique, because well-placed log messages show what the program is doing at each stage. By combining these strategies, you can find and fix errors faster and with less frustration.
